title: Evaluate Division
statement: Given equations a/b=value, answer queries asking for ratios between variables, or -1.0 when no path exists.
explanation: Build a graph with reciprocal edge weights and search for a multiplicative path between query variables.

title: Nth Digit
statement: Return the digit at one-based position n in the infinite sequence 123456789101112....
explanation: Skip whole blocks of numbers with equal digit lengths, then locate the number and digit within the remaining block.

title: Binary Watch
statement: Return all valid times on a binary watch with exactly turnedOn LEDs lit.
explanation: Enumerate hours 0..11 and minutes 0..59, keeping pairs whose combined set-bit count matches turnedOn.

title: Remove K Digits
statement: Remove k digits from a nonnegative decimal string to produce the smallest possible number.
explanation: Maintain increasing digits and remove larger trailing digits when a smaller digit arrives; strip leading zeros afterward.

title: Frog Jump
statement: Determine whether a frog can cross stones at sorted positions, starting with a jump of one and changing each jump length by at most one.
explanation: For each stone, track jump lengths that can land there and propagate k-1, k, and k+1 to reachable stones.

title: Sum of Left Leaves
statement: Return the sum of values of all left leaf nodes in a binary tree.
explanation: When a node's left child is a leaf, add its value; otherwise recurse into the child subtrees.

title: Convert a Number to Hexadecimal
statement: Convert a 32-bit signed integer to lowercase hexadecimal without using built-in conversion functions.
explanation: Repeatedly extract the lowest four bits and shift right; treating the value as unsigned handles negative inputs in two's complement.

title: Queue Reconstruction by Height
statement: Reconstruct a queue from pairs [height,k], where k is the number of people in front with height at least that person's height.
explanation: Sort by height descending and k ascending, then insert each person at index k.

title: Trapping Rain Water II
statement: Compute the total water trapped in a 2D height map after raining.
explanation: Seed all boundary cells in a min-heap and expand inward; each unvisited neighbor traps water up to the current boundary level.

title: Longest Palindrome
statement: Return the maximum palindrome length constructible from the letters of a string.
explanation: Use all pairs of matching characters and optionally one odd-count character as the center.
